custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create an active part, part A, for this test, with a description, description 1.
  • Use a new description, description 2, that no part uses.
  • Create an inactive part, part B, for this test, with a description, description 3.
  • Give parts A and B part numbers that start with the same text, so one search lists both.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.

How to set this up on the QA site (https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com):

  • Admin at the test location: on the QA site's sign-in screen choose Admin. The test location is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919; its name shows in the box at the top right. If another name shows, click that box, click the name beside Change Location: and pick Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • To create a part: click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill Description and Part Number (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425760-A for part A, -B for part B), pick a Category, type a Cost and a Sell Price, type the Quantity in the bin row (the location's bin, for example General Storage, is offered), then click Save. Leave Track quantities and cost of goods on for a tracked part; click it off for an untracked part. Add Bin Location adds a second bin; Vendor, Manufacturer, Core Charge, Min, Max and Tags are in the same window. Parts that must start with the same text all start ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425760-, so searching for that finds them all.
  • The Search box above the Inventory list opens when you click Search (the magnifier).
  • To set a part inactive: on the Inventory page's Active tab click Search, type its part number, click its row; in Edit Inventory Part click Inactive under Part Status, click Save, then click Deactivate in the Deactivate part? window. The part then shows on the Inactive tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Parts A and B are listed.

Step 2:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens for part A.

Step 3:

  • Description holds the spaces and description 2.

Step 4:

  • Inactive is picked.

Step 5:

  • The confirmation is titled "Deactivate part?" and its first line is part A's part number followed by description 2, without the spaces, not the saved description 1.

Step 6:

  • The confirmation closes.

Step 7:

  • The window closes without saving: part A keeps description 1 and stays active.

Step 8:

  • The Inactive tab is selected.

Step 9:

  • Part B is listed.

Step 10:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens for part B.

Step 11:

  • Active is picked.

Step 12:

  • The confirmation is titled "Activate part?" and its first line is part B's part number followed by description 3.

Step 13:

  • The confirmation closes.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10823 (Story 10, Confirming and Recording a Status Change)

  • S10-R4: “Raised from the bulk bar, the confirmation opens with "{n} parts selected.", or "1 part selected." for one. Raised from the part dialog, it opens with the part number followed by the description, as they stand in the form, with spaces before and after removed.”
  • S10-R3: “Raised from the bulk bar, the confirmation is titled "Deactivate parts?" or "Activate parts?". Raised from the part dialog, it is titled "Deactivate part?" or "Activate part?".”
  • S10-N1: “If the user cancels the confirmation, no part changes status.”

Last checked against build v26.43.4-999c51d (QA site sv10647) on 11/3/2026.

References from Design

Design canvas "Parts Lifecycle Update" (https://claude.ai/artifact/Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE), 13 Oct 2026 copy, unchanged when re-read on 27 Oct 2026: board "3.3 Save asks first". Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the quotes above.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • retire-03-p3-3-confirm.png

The design's own words:

  • “Save raises "Deactivate part?" (S10-R1, S10-R3). It opens with the part number and description (S10-R4), then the three lines of S10-R6, then the optional note (S10-R10). The note here reads "Superseded by N6801-06-04X". The red Deactivate button has Cancel to its left (S10-R11). The bulk confirmation (board 4.4) is the same dialog, built from the design system Modal and Button.”
